payload.claim: The 'Out of scope' paragraph beginning 'Hand edits in this spec's own pull request' frames the DESIGN.md §5.4.1 paragraph and the .claude/skills/setup-saffron/templates/policy.yaml:37 comment as edits that 'become' true only once this spec merges. At the base commit 4e58acde, both edits were already made in commit 8e8b104b, the same commit that added this spec file: DESIGN.md already reads 'Core applies the patterns to each changed file's text at head, counting a match only when the diff adds a line inside it (SA-0416)' rather than the 'to the diff as text' wording the spec says is still current, and the template comment already reads '...then the rest of it.' This affects no criterion since both paths are forbidden and outside touches, so it drives no wrong build, but it is a false statement about the current code's prose, and a cell reading DESIGN.md as background context will see the doc already asserting the fixed behaviour while the code still has the gap the spec's own 'Problem' section describes.
